newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eramet says 1997 H1 results to show recoverY.
newsitem.headline: Eramet says 1997 H1 results to show recoverY.

text.p: French nickel producer Eramet said on Wednesday that results for the first half of 1997 should show the recovery over the second half of 1996 of demand in its three main businesses and a rise in the dollar parity.
However Eramet said in a statement that nickel prices expressed in dollar terms and rapid steel deliveries will be "significantly below" their levels for the first half of 1996.
Eramet said nickel demand had recovered sharply since the fourth quarter of 1996, pushing nickel prices higher when compared to the lows hit at the end of 1996.
A higher dollar further helped the price of nickel in Fench francs.
Rapid steel consumption has stopped its decline but remains below that of the first half of 1996. The group said a "progressive recovery" in the sector was likely during 1997.
It also said that the manganese market was on the road to recovery after falling sharply in the second half of 1996.
